## Delaware Park — Race 1, September 10, 2026

**1 mile • Dirt • $16,000 Claiming • 6 runners**
The race is scheduled for **12:20 PM ET**. ([Equibase TVG][1])

### Consensus / Handicapping Summary

**As the Bell Toles** — **Top choice / most likely winner.**
This is the strongest consensus horse. TipMeerkat lists him first, while Racing Dudes also makes him its Race 1 pick. His recent form is strong (**1-2-1-6-1-5**) and the current morning-line is around **9-5**, making him the horse to beat. The concern is that he's taking plenty of public money, so the value isn't exceptional if he gets much shorter. ([Tipmeerkat][2])

**Rules for Three** — **Best alternative / exacta horse.**
Very strong consensus second choice. TipMeerkat has him second overall and several of its individual handicappers put him on top. His recent **6-8-3-1-4-2** line includes a recent runner-up finish, suggesting he's in better current form than some of the others. At roughly **7-2**, he offers considerably more value than the favorite. ([Tipmeerkat][2])

**Stylish Gem** — **Major contender.**
The other horse receiving substantial consensus support. TipMeerkat has him second, while multiple individual tipsters select him on top. His recent form includes **two wins and two seconds in his last six**, and Jaime Rodriguez is aboard. At approximately **5-2**, he's a serious win candidate but not a huge overlay. ([Tipmeerkat][2])

**Warriors Jewel** — **Secondary/underneath contender.**
Currently around **4-1**, but consensus support is noticeably weaker than the top three. His recent form is mostly placings without a win, so I'd prefer him underneath in exactas rather than making him a primary win bet. ([Emu Bets][3])

**Forget Tomorrow** — **Value longshot.**
Around **8-1** and receiving some support from individual handicappers. The recent form includes a win, but overall consistency is inferior to the top three. He is the most interesting price horse if you're looking for an upset or an exacta booster. ([Tipmeerkat][2])

**Tapwrit Warrior** — **Least attractive.**
Around **12-1** with limited consensus support and an inconsistent recent record. I'd leave him off the main win/exacta tickets unless the odds drift substantially higher. ([Emu Bets][3])

### My betting hierarchy

**Win:** As the Bell Toles
**Value win:** Rules for Three
**Main exacta horses:** As the Bell Toles / Rules for Three / Stylish Gem
**Price horse:** Forget Tomorrow
**Underneath:** Warriors Jewel
**Fade:** Tapwrit Warrior

**Projected order:** **As the Bell Toles → Rules for Three → Stylish Gem → Forget Tomorrow/Warriors Jewel**

The strongest consensus is clearly **As the Bell Toles**, but **Rules for Three is my preferred value play** because the likely price is substantially better. ([Tipmeerkat][2])

## Delaware Park — Race 2, September 10, 2026

**5½ furlongs • Dirt • 7 runners**

I checked the current race card and available handicapping information. The consensus is fairly tight, but **Little Lance** is the clearest top selection. ([Rezilta][1])

### 🏇 Horse-by-horse

**Little Lance — TOP PICK**
Best overall combination of recent form and speed. His last six starts are **8-4-3-3-4-2**, showing considerable consistency without getting the win. The **Paco Lopez** booking is a positive, and current odds around **3-1** make him playable rather than an unreasonably short favorite. ([Rezilta][1])

**The Judge And Jury — MAIN CHALLENGER**
Recent form **4-7-4-4-6-1** includes a win last time out. He has enough tactical speed to be dangerous in a short sprint, and the Kravets/Ramos combination deserves respect. Around **4-1**, he's an attractive exacta partner and legitimate win alternative. ([Rezilta][1])

**Aint No Joke — VALUE CONTENDER**
Form is mixed (**2-5-9-5-8-3**), but the latest third-place finish is encouraging. At roughly **5-1**, he offers more upside than the favorites and is worth including in exotics.

**City Panda — EXOTIC VALUE**
The **7-1** range makes this one interesting. The recent form isn't inspiring enough for a primary win bet, but there is enough prior competitiveness to include underneath.

**Trophy Room — SECONDARY**
Around **9-1** and coming off a win. The question is whether he can reproduce that effort against this group. Worth considering underneath, particularly if the odds drift upward.

**Powerful — LONGSHOT**
Approximately **9-1**. Recent form doesn't provide much evidence for a win, but could sneak into the lower exotics.

**Valore — BIG LONGSHOT**
Around **11-1** with limited recent form to recommend him. I'd need a substantial odds improvement to consider him seriously.

### My betting hierarchy

**Win:** Little Lance
**Value win:** The Judge And Jury / Aint No Joke
**Exacta core:** Little Lance + The Judge And Jury
**Add for value:** Aint No Joke, City Panda
**Deep exotic:** Trophy Room

**Projected finish:**
**Little Lance → The Judge And Jury → Aint No Joke → City Panda/Trophy Room**

**Best betting angle:** Little Lance looks like the safest horse, but **The Judge And Jury is the more interesting price alternative**. I would avoid taking Little Lance at a dramatically shorter price than the current ~3-1. ([Rezilta][1])
